_about: Single source for every card in the fan and the chapters (build spec §6.6). Video items: adding a real video = encode it (scripts/encode-video.sh) + set src, poster, duration and audio, then run python3 -I scripts/make-images.py. Optional video fields: `start` (seconds) = the item plays from there (js/video.js adds #t=start to the src) and its poster/thumb are that frame, for clips whose first frame is weak; `view` [top, bottom] (fractions of the frame height) = only that band is picture (restaurants-03 is a screen recording with a white band under it): the poster is cover-cropped from the band and the card scales the <video> so the band fills it. Photo items (type "photo", client feedback 7) are stills shown in the same card frame, with no sound: make-images.py cover-crops `master` to 9:16 around the horizontal `crop` centre into `poster` (720x1280) and `thumb`. A category's optional `rail` lists its rail items in order (else: its videos by `order`); `disabled: true` hides a category everywhere (chapter, fan, icon) while keeping its data (client feedback 6: Skin & hair care is off for now). Titles and the chapter copy are for client approval. audio:false = the track carries nothing worth hearing, so no sound button: stays-07 (pousada-pool, low handling rumble at about -35 LUFS; its track was removed), stays-08 (deck-cushions, a steady hiss at about -42 LUFS) and fashion-03 (yellow-satin-lake, digital silence). fashion-05 and fashion-06 had no originals and were removed in batch 2 (docs/qa-report.md).

videos.title: Breakfast in the dome
videos.alt: High view inside a geodesic glamping dome: a whirlpool tub on white pebbles by the panoramic window, and Lorena, in a white robe, setting out breakfast for two at a small round table.

videos.title: The one-woman band
videos.alt: Elderly one-woman-band musician playing keyboard and improvised percussion (washboard, cymbal, red pot), a local attraction.

videos.title: A bath with a view
videos.alt: Lorena relaxing in a freestanding bathtub inside a geodesic dome with green mountain views.

videos.title: Sunset over the valley
videos.alt: Woman on a wooden deck overlooking a misty mountain valley at sunset, basket of firewood on the table.

videos.title: Inside the A-frame
videos.alt: A-frame cabin interior: tall curtained glass front, warm wood, orange sofa, a person at the window.

videos.title: One day in an A-frame
videos.alt: Exterior of a black A-frame glass cabin with barrel sauna and stairs; yellow title overlay "1 DIA EM" ("1 day in").

videos.title: Pool, arches & a canopy bed
videos.alt: Tour of a pousada: a plunge pool by thatched-roof suites, a sofa niche under arched alcoves, a canopy bed draped in white voile, a rustic bathroom and a wooden deck by the pool.

videos.title: Coffee on the A-frame deck
videos.alt: Sitting barefoot in a black dress on the wooden deck of a glass A-frame cabin, a small table with a coffee cup and a book beside her.

videos.title: The deck with the hot tub
videos.alt: In a white beanie and linen trousers on a wooden deck beside a round wooden hot tub, a forested mountain valley behind.

videos.title: Golden hour on the deck
videos.alt: Golden hour under a parasol on a wooden deck: Lorena and a man in a cap share drinks at a low table, forested hills behind.

videos.title: The kitchen, from above
videos.alt: Seen from above in a white beanie and linen trousers, a hand on a marble kitchen island set with a gas hob, plates and a sprig of rosemary.

videos.title: Cooking for two
videos.alt: Lorena and a man in a cap cooking together at a marble counter in a wooden loft kitchen, trees through the window behind them.

videos.title: A bath among the trees
videos.alt: Lorena in a freestanding bathtub by a window full of trees, a man in a cap sitting on the wooden floor beside it.

videos.title: Cushions above the forest
videos.alt: On a wooden deck above the forest, Lorena, wrapped in a white robe, and a man in a cap and a striped shirt settle onto white cushions with a bottle and two glasses.

videos.title: Gnocchi night with Pronto Light
videos.alt: Lorena takes a PRONTO Light stuffed gnocchi from the fridge, heats it and eats it at a sunlit wooden table set with white orchids, a candle and a glass of red.

videos.title: A colorful table
videos.alt: With her curly hair up, in a black top, Lorena sips orange juice at a wooden table set with a colorful vegetarian spread: a big salad with tomato, mango and flowers, golden rice, greens with pansies and a chocolate dessert under marigold petals.

videos.title: A glass of white
videos.alt: In a white halter top on a red banquette, Lorena tastes a glass of white wine, then shares small plates served on blue-and-white china: bruschetta, cheese, figs and a tart.

videos.title: Breakfast among plants
videos.alt: Lorena arrives with a straw bag and has breakfast at a café full of plants: a fruit cup, fresh juices, an open sandwich and croquettes on blue-patterned plates, then a look at the terrace by the water.

videos.title: Burgundy blazer, red sneakers
videos.alt: In a burgundy blazer over a white shirt, denim shorts and red suede sneakers, Lorena leans on a stone wall, ties her laces and walks a city street and a flight of stone steps, coffee in hand.

videos.title: A teal dress at golden hour
videos.alt: Barefoot on a wooden deck above forested hills, Lorena turns in a long open-back teal and blue slip dress and leans on the railing into the low sun.

videos.title: Yellow satin by the lake
videos.alt: In a long yellow satin dress with straps crossed over the open back, Lorena walks a wooden pier on a lake, then turns on the lawn among palm trees, hair pinned up.

videos.title: Sandals & a picnic
videos.alt: A picnic on the grass: Lorena in a white tank top, denim shorts and a green headscarf lays out bread, fruit and flowers by a wicker basket, brown buckle sandals on her feet.

videos.title: At the CHANEL boutique
videos.alt: At a CHANEL boutique counter, in a black blazer and a white shirt, Lorena tries makeup and the red N°1 bottle at a mirror, holds a bottle of N°5 to her cheek and leafs through CHANEL books.

videos.title: Towel turban, ALVA in hand
videos.alt: Her hair in a white towel turban and a black strapless top, she holds up a frosted ALVA stick, opens it and shows the white bar, against a concrete wall.

videos.title: The black gown
videos.alt: Full-length in a black cut-out gown with a plunging neckline, a silver choker and a bracelet, against a white wall.

videos.title: Zebra print, head to toe
videos.alt: In sunglasses and a matching pink-and-brown zebra-print top and flared trousers, arms out against a grey wall above a mosaic pavement.

videos.title: Black tailoring, tan bag
videos.alt: Seen from behind in a black blazer and trousers, a tan leather bag across her back, against a concrete wall.

videos.title: Lace-up boots
videos.alt: Legs raised against a grey wall in chunky black lace-up boots.

videos.title: A slow morning ritual
videos.alt: Top-down: hand holding a cup of dark drink (tea/coffee) on a green ceramic saucer, wooden table. Shows a ritual moment; no product is visible.

videos.title: Brushes & glow
videos.alt: Hand with white manicure picking up makeup brushes beside a beauty sponge.

videos.title: Chanel, after the bath
videos.alt: Lorena in a dark robe in the bathroom holding a white CHANEL skincare tube to her face.

videos.title: At the beauty counter
videos.alt: Split frame at a beauty counter: Lorena looking down / close-up applying product in a mirror.

videos.title: Hair care, mirror time
videos.alt: Lorena in a navy robe at the bathroom mirror, hair-care bottles on the counter.

videos.title: Espresso by the window
videos.alt: Hand lifting an espresso cup from its saucer by a window (frame appears letterboxed). No product is visible.
